title: jtasks plan
description: The plan (or one batch of it) that `jtasks plan` / `jtasks plan --add` takes: a list of tasks, or an object with `tasks`.

feature.description: Short slug of the feature (names the run).

objective.description: One line: what the run achieves.

source.description: The spec, issue or document the plan came from (a path or a URL); every task without its own source shows it in its ticket.

profiles.description: Agent profiles by name; without it: execute, execute-deep, review.

serialize.description: Commands that must run one at a time on the machine (e.g. "bun test"); they run through jlock run.

maxAttempts.description: Attempts before a task fails (default 2). A subagent that ends without finishing does not spend one: see maxAgentEnded.

maxAgentEnded.description: Times a task's subagent may end without finishing before the task fails and the run pauses for a person (default 3).

awaitGrace.description: How long a task whose subagent ended while its process ran waits for the subagent to come back once the process ended (default 5m).

holdTtl.description: How long a task's locks live if nobody renews or gives them back, e.g. 2h (the default): the ttl of every jlock hold. The mod and the plugin renew the locks of tasks in progress, so it only frees a window that died.

keepalive.description: False creates the run with the keepalive off: the host does not reopen the loop when the orchestrator stops with ready tasks (default true).

branch.description: Commit on gt/<run> (default) or on the current branch.

shared.description: Registry files, indexes, schemas and central types several tasks touch. jtasks validate warns about two tasks with no dependency between them touching one (in files or touchesShared).

sharedPolicy.description: warn (the default): only the warning; serialize: two tasks touching the same shared file never run at the same time (the frontier holds one back), without the file entering both ownerships.

what.description: What to build: the end-to-end behaviour this task makes work, from the user's side; no file paths (they go in files) and no code.

source.description: Where this task came from, when it is not the plan's source.

dependsOn.description: Ids of the tasks that block this one.

files.description: Files and folders it owns, relative to the repository; a folder owns everything inside; dir/** is the folder; no other patterns.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria: each one observable, false at the commit the task starts from, and made true by this task alone.

boundary.description: Scope boundary: what this task does not do.

exclusive.description: Touches too much or unknown files: runs alone.

touchesShared.description: Files of the plan's shared this task touches without owning them (it claims them when it needs them).
